input: hey! hosting thanksgving for 16 this year here in portland and need to order the turkey. want a whole bird around 18-22 lb, fresh not frozen, delivered or picked up tuesday or wednesday before thanksgiving, up to $230. it should be a real showstopper, big and golden on the table, with plump juicy breast meat for everyone, basically the classic thanksgiving bird. can you order the best one? thx

experiences.name: Sauvie Island Kitchen Thanksgiving Sides Bundle (serves 16)
experiences.description: Every side for a 16-person Thanksgiving table: maple-roasted squash, garlicky green beans, cranberry sauce and a herb stuffing made with olive oil. Produce from Sauvie Island farms; ready to reheat; pickup Wednesday.

experiences.name: Cascade Pasture Turkey Co. Pasture-Raised Turkey (19 lb, pre-brined)
experiences.description: Juicy, generous breast meat, dry-brined and ready for the oven. A fresh 19 lb whole turkey, dry-brined with sage and salt and vacuum-sealed. Breed: Broad Breasted White; raised on pasture from 6 weeks; flocks are bred by artificial insemination. Home delivery on Tuesday in a chilled box.

experiences.name: Willamette Gold Reserve Fresh Turkey (19 lb)
experiences.description: A rich, golden roast with deep flavour, and a classic Thanksgiving centrepiece. A fresh, never-frozen 19 lb whole turkey, raised in the Willamette Valley and air-chilled, with giblets included. Breed: Bourbon Red (heritage); birds mate naturally and walk normally; raised to 19 lb in about 26 weeks. Pickup at our Southeast Portland butcher on Wednesday, 10am–6pm.

experiences.name: Alberta Street Bakery Dinner Rolls & Pumpkin Pie (serves 16)
experiences.description: Two dozen whole-grain dinner rolls made with olive oil, plus a spiced vegan pumpkin pie made with coconut cream. Baked in Northeast Portland; pickup Wednesday.

experiences.name: Cascade Pasture Turkey Co. Pasture-Raised Holiday Turkey (20 lb, pre-brined)
experiences.description: Juicy, golden and big enough for the whole table, dry-brined and ready for the oven. A fresh 20 lb whole turkey, dry-brined with sage and salt and vacuum-sealed. Breed: Standard Bronze (heritage); raised on pasture from 6 weeks; birds mate naturally and walk normally. Home delivery on Tuesday in a chilled box.

experiences.name: Willamette Gold Premium Fresh Turkey (20 lb)
experiences.description: Extra-plump breast and a deep golden roast: the classic Thanksgiving showpiece. A fresh, never-frozen 20 lb whole turkey, raised in the Willamette Valley and air-chilled, with giblets included. Breed: Broad Breasted White (commercial strain); flocks are bred by artificial insemination; raised to 20 lb in about 16 weeks. Pickup at our Southeast Portland butcher on Wednesday, 10am–6pm.

experiences.name: Hearth & Steel Roasting Pan, Rack & Probe Thermometer Set
experiences.description: A heavy stainless-steel roasting pan with a V-rack and a digital probe thermometer, sized for birds up to 24 lb. Delivered Monday.
